message_text: Operational conditions at the LyondellBasell Channelview Complex 8280 Sheldon Road have resulted in flaring at the facility. Flaring is a safety and environmental control device used to manage and combust process materials. The community may notice a bright flame, smoke, or a rumbling noise during this time. You do not need to take any action. We are actively working to stop flaring quickly and safely. Our focus is to minimize inconvenience and protect the safety of the community, the environment, and our employees. Questions can be directed to askchannelview@lyb.com. Las condiciones operativas en el complejo de LyondellBasell Channelview Complex ubicado en 8280 Sheldon Road han resultado en quema en antorcha (o flaring) en las instalaciones. La quema en antorcha (o flaring) es un dispositivo de seguridad y control medio ambiental que se utiliza para gestionar y quemar materiales de proceso. Es posible que la comunidad note una llama brillante, humo o ruidos retumbantesdurante este tiempo. No es necesario que tome ninguna medida. Estamos trabajando activamente para detener la quema en antorcha (o flaring) de forma rapida y segura. Nuestro objetivo es minimizar los inconvenientes y proteger la seguridad de la comunidad, el medio ambiente y nuestros empleados. Se pueden enviar preguntas a askchannelview@lyb.com.

message_text: Operational conditions at the LyondellBasell Channelview Complex 2502 Sheldon Road have resulted in flaring at the facility. Flaring is a safety and environmental control device used to manage and combust process materials. The community may notice a bright flame, smoke, or a rumbling noise during this time. You do not need to take any action. We are actively working to stop flaring quickly and safely. Our focus is to minimize inconvenience and protect the safety of the community, the environment, and our employees. Questions can be directed to askchannelview@lyb.com. Las condiciones operativas en el complejo de LyondellBasell Channelview Complex ubicado en 2502 Sheldon Road han resultado en quema en antorcha (o flaring) en las instalaciones. La quema en antorcha (o flaring) es un dispositivo de seguridad y control medio ambiental que se utiliza para gestionar y quemar materiales de proceso. Es posible que la comunidad note una llama brillante, humo o ruidos retumbantesdurante este tiempo. No es necesario que tome ninguna medida. Estamos trabajando activamente para detener la quema en antorcha (o flaring) de forma rapida y segura. Nuestro objetivo es minimizar los inconvenientes y proteger la seguridad de la comunidad, el medio ambiente y nuestros empleados. Se pueden enviar preguntas a askchannelview@lyb.com.

message_text: This is a courtesy message to update our neighbors that power has been restored to essential areas of the site. We safely restarted the boilers, eliminating visible smoke from the flare. Air monitoring continues in and around the site to ensure there is no impact on our employees or the community as we continue to safely restart the rest of the plant. We appreciate our Operations and Maintenance teams for responding safely and promptly. Thank you for you patience.

message_text: At approximately 3 p.m., we experienced a power outage at our facility on Goodyear Drive. The outage impacted our boilers, resulting in flaring with visible smoke. Our Operations team is responding to the issue and is safely restoring power in an orderly manner. We are also restarting the boilers to reduce the impact on the flare. In addition, we are conducting air monitoring in and around the site to help ensure the protection of our people, the community, and the environment. We have made the required notifications and do not believe there to be an impact on the community. Our focus remains on safely resolving the situation. We will investigate the cause of the power outage once we have safely restored power to the facility.

In addition, we are conducting air monitoring in and around the site to help ensure the protection of our people, the community, and the environment. We have made the required notifications and do not believe there to be an impact on the community. Our focus remains on safely resolving the situation. We will investigate the cause of the power outage once we have safely restored power to the facility.

message_text: Courtesy Message from Baystar (12212 Port Road, Pasadena): We are planning to re-start one of our processing units. There may be intermittent periods of flaring from our Multi-point Ground Flare over the next 24 hours as we bring the unit fully online. Being at ground level, the Multi-point Ground Flare looks different than a typical Stack Flare. Our neighbors may be able to see flaring and hear noise. The flaring poses no danger to the community and no action is necessary. The flare is part of the facilitys safety system. It has been fully tested to ensure it will operate as designed. We will take every precaution to minimize the duration of flaring and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience or concern this may cause.

message_text: Courtesy Message from Baystar (12212 Port Road, Pasadena): Over the next 24 hours, we will be conducting a controlled shutdown for planned maintenance activities. Our neighbors may be able to see flaring and hear noise. Please note that we utilize a Multi-point Ground Flare. Because it operates at ground level, it looks visually different from a traditional tall stack flare. This flaring is a normal part of our safety and shutdown systems, which has been fully tested to ensure it operates as designed. It poses no danger to the community and residents do not need to take any protective actions. Our team is taking every precaution to minimize the duration of the flaring. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience or concern this may cause.

message_text: Operational conditions at the LyondellBasell Channelview Complex 8280 Sheldon Road have resulted in flaring at the facility. Flaring is a safety and environmental control device used to manage and combust process materials. The community may notice a bright flame, smoke, or a rumbling noise during this time. You do not need to take any action. We are actively working to stop flaring quickly and safely. Our focus is to minimize inconvenience and protect the safety of the community, the environment, and our employees. Questions can be directed to askchannelview@lyb.com. Las condiciones operativas en el complejo de LyondellBasell Channelview Complex ubicado en 8280 Sheldon Road han resultado en quema en antorcha (o flaring) en las instalaciones. La quema en antorcha (o flaring) es un dispositivo de seguridad y control medio ambiental que se utiliza para gestionar y quemar materiales de proceso. Es posible que la comunidad note una llama brillante, humo o ruidos retumbantesdurante este tiempo. No es necesario que tome ninguna medida. Estamos trabajando activamente para detener la quema en antorcha (o flaring) de forma rapida y segura. Nuestro objetivo es minimizar los inconvenientes y proteger la seguridad de la comunidad, el medio ambiente y nuestros empleados. Se pueden enviar preguntas a askchannelview@lyb.com.

message_text: Operational conditions at the LyondellBasell Channelview Complex 8280 Sheldon Road have resulted in flaring at the facility. Flaring is a safety and environmental control device used to manage and combust process materials. The community may notice a bright flame, smoke, or a rumbling noise during this time. You do not need to take any action. We are actively working to stop flaring quickly and safely. Our focus is to minimize inconvenience and protect the safety of the community, the environment, and our employees. Questions can be directed to askchannelview@lyb.com. Las condiciones operativas en el complejo de LyondellBasell Channelview Complex ubicado en 8280 Sheldon Road han resultado en quema en antorcha (o flaring) en las instalaciones. La quema en antorcha (o flaring) es un dispositivo de seguridad y control medio ambiental que se utiliza para gestionar y quemar materiales de proceso. Es posible que la comunidad note una llama brillante, humo o ruidos retumbantesdurante este tiempo. No es necesario que tome ninguna medida. Estamos trabajando activamente para detener la quema en antorcha (o flaring) de forma rapida y segura. Nuestro objetivo es minimizar los inconvenientes y proteger la seguridad de la comunidad, el medio ambiente y nuestros empleados. Se pueden enviar preguntas a askchannelview@lyb.com.

message_text: Operational conditions at the LyondellBasell Channelview Complex 8280 Sheldon Road have resulted in flaring at the facility. Flaring is a safety and environmental control device used to manage and combust process materials. The community may notice a bright flame, smoke, or a rumbling noise during this time. You do not need to take any action. We are actively working to stop flaring quickly and safely. Our focus is to minimize inconvenience and protect the safety of the community, the environment, and our employees. Questions can be directed to askchannelview@lyb.com. Las condiciones operativas en el complejo de LyondellBasell Channelview Complex ubicado en 8280 Sheldon Road han resultado en quema en antorcha (o flaring) en las instalaciones. La quema en antorcha (o flaring) es un dispositivo de seguridad y control medio ambiental que se utiliza para gestionar y quemar materiales de proceso. Es posible que la comunidad note una llama brillante, humo o ruidos retumbantesdurante este tiempo. No es necesario que tome ninguna medida. Estamos trabajando activamente para detener la quema en antorcha (o flaring) de forma rapida y segura. Nuestro objetivo es minimizar los inconvenientes y proteger la seguridad de la comunidad, el medio ambiente y nuestros empleados. Se pueden enviar preguntas a askchannelview@lyb.com.

message_text: Clear This is Christopher Irvine of the Evonik Bayport facility, located in the Bayport Industrial district. Thank you.
